title: Every written CST stamp is checked against the clock
why: Triage stamps ran 11-16 min ahead of now-central from about 09:50 to 09:57 CST Nov 13 (audit 10:01 CST). That covered the handoff header, a push time and a runner message. The message-time hook checks send_message only, and caught one at 10:00 CST. Handoff headers, step notes and page reply stamps are not checked.
note: Fix: extend the message-time check (its one home) to handoff writes and roadmap step note stamps, with the same 1-minute limit. Done when: a test writes a handoff stamped 10 minutes ahead and is refused. Incident 11:11 CST Nov 13 (coordinator): batch runner 11 stamped a message 11:15 CST at 11:11 CST, 4 minutes ahead; a second session with the same drift.
